title: Open redirect via unchecked next parameter on login
description: After login the app redirects to the value of the next query parameter without checking it is a local path. A link like /login?next=https://evil.example/phish sends authenticated users off-site, useful for phishing and OAuth token theft. redirect_after_login in auth/flow.py passes next straight to redirect().
poc_text: Visit /login?next=https://evil.example/ and complete login; the response redirects off-site.
